units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 9:25">Targ. Gen. IX, 25</cite> (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="P00014"><he>עַבַד</he></cite>; ed. Vien. <cite ref="P00015"><he>עֶבֶד</he></cite>). Ib. 26; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86:3">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> <he>ע׳ זבין … ע׳ לתרויהון</he> a slave (Potiphar) buys, the son of a handmaid (the Ishmaelite) sells, and the free man (Joseph) is the slave of both; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:7:1">Koh. R. to X, 7</cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 13a:1">Gitt. 13ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ע׳ בהפקרא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00760"><he>הֶפְקֵרָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:27">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᶜ</cite> <he>נפק ע׳</he>, read: <cite ref="P00175"><he>עוּבְדָּא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>עַבְדִּין</he>, <he>עַבְדַּיָּא</he>, <he>עַבְדֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 54:17">Targ. Is. LIV, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 12:9">Targ. Prov. XII, 9</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97a:5">B. Kam. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה תקיף ע׳ דאינשי וכ׳</he> used to seize slaves of men against whom he had a claim &c.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 70a:12">Kidd. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>רגיל דקרי אינשי ע׳</he> he is in the habit of calling people slaves; a. fr.
